en: Paṭṭhānapakaraṇa:
Dhammapaccanīyānuloma (4), Tikadukapaṭṭhānapāḷi (4) 22.35.
The Triplet on the Visible (Sanidassanattika), beginning with the Couplets on Abandonment by Seeing (Dassanenapahātabbaduka), etc.

Conditioned by a state that is non-demonstrable, with resistance, and not to be abandoned by vision, there arises a state that is non-demonstrable, without resistance, and to be abandoned by vision, by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. Three under root; ... pe ... three under non-disappearance.

Dependent on a state that is non-demonstrable, with resistance, and not to be abandoned by vision, there arises a state that is demonstrable, with resistance, and not to be abandoned by vision, by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. Twenty-one under root.
... pe ... by predominance, twenty-one ... pe ... by non-disappearance, twenty-one.

Conditioned by a state that is non-visible, impinging, and not to be abandoned by cultivation, there arises a state that is non-visible, non-impinging, and to be abandoned by cultivation, through the root-condition. (Abbreviated. By the root-condition, three ... pe ... by non-disappearance, three.
Dependent on a state that is non-visible, impinging, and not to be abandoned by cultivation, [there arises] a state that is visible and impinging...
A state to be abandoned by non-cultivation arises by way of the root condition. (Abbreviated. Twenty-one [factors] in the case of the root;
twenty-one in the case of the predominance [condition] ... pe ... twenty-one in the case of non-disappearance.
Dependent on a state that is non-demonstrable, non-reacting, and has a root to be abandoned by non-seeing, there arises a state that is non-demonstrable and non-reacting ... [and so forth].

A state rooted in what is to be abandoned by vision arises conditioned by a root cause. (Abbreviated. Under root condition there are three; ... pe ... under non-disappearance condition there are three.

Dependent on a state that is visible, impinging, and not rooted in what is to be abandoned by vision, there arises a state that is visible, impinging, and not rooted in what is to be abandoned by vision, conditioned by a root cause. (Abbreviated. Under root condition there are twenty-one.
With respect to the object, three ... [and so on] ... with respect to non-disappearance, twenty-one.

Conditioned by a state that is non-demonstrable, non-reactive, and whose root is not to be abandoned by cultivation, there arises a state that is non-demonstrable, non-reactive, and whose root is to be abandoned by cultivation, by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. With respect to root, three ... [and so on] ... with respect to non-disappearance, three.

Dependent on a state that is visible, impinging, and has roots to be abandoned by cultivation, there arises a state that is visible, impinging, and has roots to be abandoned by cultivation, by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. Under root condition, twenty-one;
under object condition, three ... pe ... under non-disappearance condition, twenty-one.

Dependent on a state that is non-visible, non-reacting, and without applied thought, there arises a state that is non-visible, non-reacting, and with applied thought, by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. Under root condition there are three; ... pe ... under non-disappearance condition there are three.

Dependent on a state that is non-visible, non-reacting, and without applied thought, there arises a state that is visible, reacting, and without applied thought, by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. Under root condition there are twenty-one; under object condition there are three; ... pe ... under non-disappearance condition there are twenty-one.

Dependent on a state that is non-visible, non-reacting, and without sustained thought, there arises a state that is non-visible, non-reacting, and with sustained thought, by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. Under root condition there are three; ... pe ... under non-disappearance condition there are three.

Dependent on a state that is non-visible, non-reacting, and without sustained thought, there arises a state that is visible, reacting, and without sustained thought, by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. Under root condition there are twenty-one; under object condition there are three; ... pe ... under non-disappearance condition there are twenty-one.

Dependent on a state that is non-visible, non-reacting, and without rapture, there arises a state that is non-visible, non-reacting, and with rapture, by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. Three under root; ... pe ... three under non-disappearance.

Dependent on a state that is non-visible, non-reacting, and without rapture, there arises a state that is visible, reacting, and without rapture, by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. Twenty-one under root; three under object; ... pe ... twenty-one under non-disappearance.

Dependent on a state that is non-visible, non-reacting, and not accompanied by rapture, there arises a state that is non-visible, non-reacting, and accompanied by rapture, by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. Three under root; ... pe ... three under non-disappearance.

Dependent on a state that is non-visible, non-reacting, and not accompanied by rapture, there arises a state that is visible, reacting, and not accompanied by rapture, by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. Twenty-one under root; under object—
Three ... [and so on] ... twenty-one in the case of non-disappearance.

Dependent on a state that is non-visible, non-reacting, and not accompanied by pleasure, there arises a state that is non-visible, non-reacting, and accompanied by pleasure, by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. Three in the case of root ... [and so on] ... three in the case of non-disappearance.
Dependent on a state that is non-visible, non-reacting, and not accompanied by pleasure, there arises a state that is visible and reacting ...
A state accompanied by pleasure arises conditioned by a cause. (Abbreviated. Under the cause-condition there are twenty-one;
under the object-condition, three ... pe ... under the non-disappearance-condition, twenty-one.

In dependence on a state that is non-visible, non-reacting, and not accompanied by equanimity, a state that is invisible, non-reacting, and accompanied by equanimity arises conditioned by a cause. (Abbreviated. Under the cause-condition there are three ... pe ... under the non-disappearance-condition, three.
Dependent on a state that is visible, impinging, and not accompanied by equanimity, there arises a state that is visible, impinging, and not accompanied by equanimity, by way of root condition.
(Abbreviated. Under root condition there are twenty-one; under object condition there are three ...
pe ... under non-disappearance condition there are twenty-one.
Dependent on a state that is visible and impinging, not belonging to the sense sphere, there arises a state that is visible and impinging, belonging to the sense sphere, by way of root condition.
(Abbreviated. Under root condition there are twenty-one; under predominance condition there are twenty-one ...
pe ... under mutuality condition there are three ... pe ... under non-disappearance condition there are twenty-one.

Dependent on a state that is non-demonstrable, with resistance, and not of the sense-sphere, there arises a state that is non-demonstrable, without resistance, and not of the sense-sphere, by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. Three under root; ... pe ... three under non-disappearance.

Dependent on a state that is non-demonstrable, with resistance, and not of the fine-material sphere, there arises a state that is non-demonstrable, without resistance, and of the fine-material sphere, by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. Three under root; ... pe ... three under non-disappearance.

Dependent on a state that is not visible and impinging, not belonging to the fine-material sphere, another state that is visible and impinging, not belonging to the fine-material sphere, arises by way of root condition.
(Abbreviated. Under root condition there are twenty-one; under predominance condition there are twenty-one ...
pe ... under mutuality condition there are three ... pe ... under non-disappearance condition there are twenty-one.

Conditioned by a phenomenon that is non-visible, with resistance, and not pertaining to the formless sphere, a phenomenon that is non-visible, without resistance, and not pertaining to the formless sphere arises by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. Three under root; ... pe ... three under non-disappearance.

Dependent on a phenomenon that is non-visible, with resistance, and not pertaining to the formless sphere, a phenomenon that is visible, with resistance, and not pertaining to the formless sphere arises by way of root condition.
(Abbreviated. Twenty-one under root; twenty-one under predominance; ... pe ... twenty-one under non-disappearance.
Dependent on a state that is non-visible, non-reacting, and not included [in the mundane], there arises a state that is visible, reacting, and included, by way of root condition.
(Abbreviated. Twenty-one under root; twenty-one under predominance ... pe ... twenty-one under non-disappearance.

Dependent on a state that is non-visible, non-reacting, and not included, there arises a state that is non-visible, non-reacting, and not included, by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. Three under root ... pe ... three under non-disappearance.

Conditioned by a state that is non-demonstrable, impinging, and not leading to emergence, there arises a state that is non-demonstrable, non-impinging, and leading to emergence, by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. Three under root; ... pe ... three under non-disappearance.
Dependent on a state that is non-demonstrable, impinging, and not leading to emergence, there arises a state that is demonstrable, impinging, and not leading to emergence, by way of root condition.
(Abbreviated. Twenty-one under root; twenty-one under predominance; ... pe ... twenty-one under non-disappearance.

Conditioned by a state that is non-visible, non-reacting, and indeterminate, a state that is non-visible, non-reacting, and determinate arises by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. Three under root; ... pe ... three under non-disappearance.
In dependence on a state that is non-visible, non-reacting, and indeterminate, a state that is visible, reacting, and indeterminate arises by way of root condition.
(Abbreviated. Twenty-one under root; twenty-one under predominance; ... pe ... twenty-one under non-disappearance.
Dependent on a state that is non-visible, non-reacting, and not unsurpassed, there arises a state that is visible, reacting, and surpassed, by way of root condition.
(Abbreviated. Under root condition: twenty-one; under predominance condition: twenty-one ... pe ... under non-disappearance condition: twenty-one.

Dependent on a state that is non-visible, non-reacting, and not unsurpassed, there arises a state that is non-visible, non-reacting, and unsurpassed, by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. Under root condition: three ... pe ... under non-disappearance condition: three.
